claims.evidence: Witness photos show two stacked electronic keyboards with control panels, but no readable brand/model text; identity is listed as unknown.
Photos do not show power-on testing, sound output, or key/button responsiveness.
No charger/adapter is shown in the witness report.
No documentation or markings confirming UK origin are shown.
No audio/video test or key-by-key check is shown.

risks.risk: Wrong model/brand (photos don’t show readable Yamaha/DGX 520 markings), which can materially change value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model/brand label (rear panel and/or underside) showing 'Yamaha' and 'DGX 520'.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified generic/unknown electronic keyboard (worst-case: lower-tier model/condition).

risks.risk: Non-working or intermittent keys/buttons (dead keys, stuck keys, crackling audio) not detectable from still photos.
risks.proof: Short video: power on, play a scale across the full keyboard, press multiple buttons/controls, and show audio output (volume up/down).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / potentially faulty (worst-case: needs repair).

risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter/charger label (output voltage/current) and a clip showing it powering the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: Price as adapter not guaranteed (worst-case: buyer must source a compatible adapter).

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible in the provided shots (warped/missing keys, cracked casing, damaged knobs/buttons, screen issues).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: keybed (all keys), control knobs/buttons, display/screen (if any), and corners/edges for cracks/dents.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic condition (as-is with possible wear/damage).

risks.risk: Accessories/stands/pedals not included (value depends on what comes with it).
risks.proof: Photo inventory of everything included: sustain pedal(s), stand, cables, manuals, and any storage bag/case.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal included items only (worst-case: no stand/pedal/manual).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the keyboard’s model/serial label showing Yamaha and 'DGX 520' (rear/underside).
Short power-on video showing keys working across the full range and buttons/controls responding, with audible output.
Photo of the included adapter/charger label (voltage/current) and a clip powering the keyboard.
Close-up photos of the entire keybed, all knobs/buttons, and the display/screen (if present), plus corners/edges for cracks/dents.
response.reason: The witness confirms the item type as electronic keyboards, but brand/model and functionality are not verifiable from the photos. Still, a worst-case price can be set for an unverified, potentially lower-value keyboard until proof of the exact Yamaha DGX 520 and working condition is provided.
